analysis_result.description: the laboratory result confirming whether the material is asbestos

competent_person.description: the competent person who identified the material

external_id.description: the source's own register entry id

identification_basis.description: whether the material was identified by analysis or assumed

identified_on.description: when the asbestos was identified or assumed to be present

inaccessible_area.description: whether the location is inaccessible, so presence is assumed

last_reviewed_on.description: when the register entry was last reviewed

location.description: the specific location of the material

management_plan.description: the asbestos management plan the entry belongs to

material_type.description: the type of asbestos or asbestos-containing material

no_asbestos_identified.description: whether this entry states that no asbestos has been identified

past_removal_work.description: removal work already done on the material

project.description: the project, when the workplace is a project site

review_trigger.description: why the last review happened, e.g. asbestos removed or further asbestos found

source_system.description: which bound system emitted the row
